goal: Make debug symbols in Guix binaries use uniform relative paths for all repository and generated sources
Eliminate container-specific paths to simplify source directory mapping in debuggers
agreement: Questioned usefulness because depends and system include paths remain unmapped (maflcko)
Author concurred that benefits are mostly cosmetic and offered to close or expand scope (jespada)

categories.name: build
why: P3 because it offers a minor debugging convenience for Guix-built Linux and Windows binaries
Only fixes paths for generated sources while external library and system include paths remain unmapped
